title: 云计算和 SaaS 领域的技术、基础设施和应用创新
core_insight: AWS、Google Cloud、Azure 和 SaaS 厂商如 Salesforce 和 HubSpot 在技术、基础设施和应用方面取得了显著进展，包括 serverless 计算、云原生、AI 和数字化转型

dimension_texts.technology: AWS Lambda MicroVMs、Google Cloud AlloyDB 和 CodeMender、Azure Databricks 和 Foundry 提供了新的云原生和安全功能 AWS CloudFormation Express mode、Google Cloud 更新了其基础设施和数据管理功能 Run isolated sandboxes with full lifecycle control: AWS Lambda introduces MicroVMs Supercharging pgvector: 4x faster HNSW vector search with AlloyDB Azure Databricks delivers proven business value Frontier models and production agents: Advancing Microsoft Foundry for the agentic era Introducing Precursor: detecting agentic behavior with continuous client-side signals Now in preview: Find and fix software vulnerabilities with CodeMender Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it Introducing Meerkat: an experiment in global consensus Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS CloudFormation Express mode 加速了基础设施部署，Google Cloud 更新了其定价和区域扩张策略 Amazon EC2 C9g 和 C9gd 实例提供了更好的计算性能，Google Cloud 提高了其计算能力和数据中心扩张 Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available Accelerating automotive innovation with C4A-metal and Panasonic Automotive vSkipGen Making highly available, multi-region Cloud Run services just got easier Improving Smart Tiered Cache for Public Cloud Regions
